questions.q: What does the INVERTER do in a solar system?
choices: converts the panel's DC into AC
why: No — that is the battery's job, not the inverter's.
Correct! The inverter converts the panel's DC into the AC homes use.
No — the inverter is electrical; it does not clean anything.

questions.q: About how many watts does one modern solar panel make in full sun?
why: No — that is far too small for a rooftop panel.
Correct! A typical modern panel makes roughly 400 W in full sun.
No — that is far more than a single panel produces.
